description: This file defines the LoginService class responsible for managing login logging operations within the OrangeHRM authentication system. It includes methods to add login logs for both standard and OIDC login processes, utilizing external DAOs and entity classes.

classes.name: LoginService
classes.description: Service class responsible for logging login activities, integrating with DAOs and handling user credentials.

methods.name: getLoginLogDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LoginLogDao instance used for persistence.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Creates a login log entry for a user based on provided credentials.

methods.name: addOIDCLogin
methods.description: Creates a login log entry for a user authenticated via OIDC.
